# Phase One — Boundless Completion Brainstorm

The Awtsmoos recreates every finite vessel each instant; this sprint treats Geelooy as one living product universe where discovery, return, commerce, performance, accessibility, reconciliation, workflow continuity, and trust reinforce each other.

## Everything that can move now
- Finish and globally integrate the route-only Recent/Favorite continuity layer already written but not yet exposed.
- Re-run the complete current release suite after integration, including existing commerce/Radiance/readiness/SEO/startup tests.
- Runtime-prove Recent/Favorite behavior in a production-faithful mobile browser.
- Run an isolated full server against a temporary database root and capture startup-stage timings.
- Identify and improve the measured pre-bind bottleneck without weakening durability, auth, or startup failure semantics.
- Audit wallet reservations, commits, releases, expirations, replay, and reconciliation; add operator-visible health where evidence shows gaps.
- Audit existing share/export/import/open-with patterns and add one reusable cross-product handoff primitive if absent.
- Audit global accessibility/performance on the newly shared catalog/commerce/retention layers.
- Audit public product copy and catalog metadata for weak, missing, or generic descriptions and prioritize highest-traffic conversion surfaces.
- Audit game monetization for cosmetic, convenience, replay, theme, content, and achievement value without pay-to-win mechanics.
- Audit creator/developer apps for truthful compute/storage/automation premium value backed by real fulfillment.
- Re-read every touched file and write planned-versus-actual evidence before declaring any subsystem done.

No engineering can guarantee revenue. The target is a truthful, compelling, low-friction system that maximizes sustainable conversion and retention through genuine value.
